verdict.rationale: Swell documents official Node and PHP API libraries and a first-party CLI. `swell app init` scaffolds an app, and `swell app push` deploys it to a dev store. Apps can add custom models, edge functions, webhooks and themes. The pack does not document an app review, approval or marketplace distribution path; it only mentions distributing themes within storefront apps. Missing for 10: a documented app review/publishing/marketplace process, SDKs beyond Node/PHP or a dedicated app-building SDK, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
